Chose: A served site is built into the cache, not the repository

where src/cli.ts file page

quote // serve: the site goes in the cache, never into the repository.

Because (Claude, not asked): serve.ts built into site/ beside wherever it ran, which in this repository is gitignored. Run in any repository, that's a write into it. phoropter build still writes site/ by default, because building a site is what you asked for.

Chose: Committed indexes are read from the working tree

where src/store.ts file page

quote committedPath(sha: string, pkg: string): string {

Because (Claude, not asked): an index is the same fact wherever it's read from, so the store doesn't care whether .phoropter/index/ is committed yet. That's what lets a build use what phoropter index just wrote, before it's committed.

Chose: Tests get a temporary cache

where test/cache.ts file page

quote process.env.XDG_CACHE_HOME = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'phoropter-cache-'));

Because (Claude, not asked): every build writes the cache now, and a test run shouldn't fill a real ~/.cache. Each test file that builds imports this first.

The guess's other half, symbol anchors resolving with no indexer, held in test/store.test.ts: with the plans' indexes committed and an indexer that fails in place of an uninstalled one, every symbol view came out as it did with a working indexer. scip-typescript now loads only when something has to be indexed, so a missing install can't stop the build before it starts.
